segments.iti21:2.1: “Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, ekaccaṃ puggalaṃ pasannacittaṃ evaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāmi –
segments.iti21:2.2: ‘imamhi cāyaṃ samaye puggalo kālaṃ kareyya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge’.
segments.iti21:2.5: Cetopasādahetu kho pana, bhikkhave, evamidhekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantī”ti.
segments.iti21:6.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.

lines: Tatiyavaggassa paṭhame pasannacittanti ratanattayasaddhāya kammaphalasaddhāya ca pasannamānasaṃ.
Sugatinti sundaraṃ gatiṃ, sukhassa vā gatinti sugatiṃ.
Lokanti lokiyanti ettha puññapāpaphalāni, lujjanaṭṭheneva vā lokaṃ.
Ettha ca sugatiggahaṇena manussagatipi saṅgayhati, saggaggahaṇena devagati eva.
